name: Spectacles
description: A pair of spectacles worn by Sol, a museum conservator. They hang from a cord around his neck and are removed when Sol needs to inspect detailed work closely, such as examining the exposed joint of a broken porcelain bird.
narrative_significance: The spectacles serve as a functional tool for Sol's conservation work, indicating his professional practice of removing them for close inspection of delicate restoration tasks. They are part of his character's routine and professional identity.
